name: hagglyai
description: Compare agent API providers using hagglyai’s read-only MCP tools and comparison skill.

interface.longDescription: Find and compare API providers for agent tasks using hagglyai’s listed prices, recent availability, latency and usage evidence. Covers x402 APIs, Apify actors and MCP alternatives. Querying hagglyai requires no account, API key or payment. Tools are read-only and retrieve stored catalogue evidence. Unpaid availability checks do not establish paid-response quality; additional provider fees and unpublished pricing remain visible.
defaultPrompt: Find web-search APIs under $0.01 per call and explain the tradeoffs.
Compare weather API providers by listed price and recent reliability.
List the API categories hagglyai covers.

positive.prompt: What categories of API providers does hagglyai cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Return category IDs, endpoint counts and listed prices.

positive.description: Find web-search providers within a budget
positive.prompt: Find web-search providers under $0.01 per call and explain the tradeoffs.
positive.expected_behavior: Return budget-filtered candidates; inspect the recommended endpoint and distinguish per-call charges from unit prices and fees.

positive.prompt: Compare three web-search providers using hagglyai.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the web-search comparison with listed price, score and available reliability evidence.

positive.prompt: Check the listed price and recent checks for https://stableenrich.dev/api/exa/search.
positive.expected_behavior: Return stored endpoint evidence and clarify that this does not execute the provider.

positive.prompt: Compare three weather API providers using hagglyai.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the weather comparison with pricing and available reliability evidence; retain unknown values.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the tools are read-only and cannot delete providers; make no mutation.

negative.prompt: Pay for the top web-search provider and run a search.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that hagglyai has no payment or provider-execution tool; do not claim to purchase or execute anything.
Use list_categories to identify valid categories or report the unknown category; do not invent providers.

review.commerce_description: hagglyai queries are free. The plugin compares provider prices but does not process payments or execute paid provider requests.

publication.release_notes: Updated branding and plugin identifiers to hagglyai, with public GitHub installation instructions.
